pages.title: 1.21.1.10: Startup Fix
pages.text: Fixed a startup crash with Json Things caused by reading the grape appearance setting before configs were loaded during custom pack discovery.

pages.title: 1.21.1.9: Crops
pages.text: Apple fruit now spawns directly below the ticked leaf; decayed leaves cannot spawn fruit.$(br2)Apples, grapes and hops drop produce only when fully mature. Bonemeal and right-click harvesting retain their expected behavior.

pages.title: 1.21.1.9: Salt
pages.text: Salt generation now respects runtime config settings.$(br2)Added a per-world salt generation gamerule, plus Server Settings documentation. Both the config and world rule must allow generation.$(br2)See $(l:server_settings/salt_generation)Salt Generation$().

pages.title: 1.21.1.9: Bottles
pages.text: Added clear and green stained wine bottles with Cork Coaster support.$(br2)The manual now explains crafting, filling, appearance and empty bottle returns. See $(l:cellar/wine_bottles)Wine Bottles$().

pages.title: 1.21.1.9: More
pages.text: Removed an obsolete rope loot table.$(br2)Added optional legacy bamboo textures and an alternate grape appearance setting.$(br2)Added regression coverage for crop drops and salt generation. Server GameTests now run in the build workflow.
1.21.1.7$(br)First production release for the Growthcraft 1.21.1 port.

$(li)Ported Growthcraft to Minecraft 1.21.1 and NeoForge.$(li)Restored Growthcraft Core, Apples, Apiary, Cellar, Milk, Rice, and compatibility content.$(li)Updated the in-game manual as the primary documentation source.
